data.title: 和栗薰子 · 图书馆里认真核对的一行
data.description: 放学后的社区图书馆，桔梗学园的薰子穿校园制服坐在木桌前，用铅笔沿着笔记中的一行慢慢核对。她发现漏掉的小符号后写在便签上，再抬起蓝色眼睛温柔一笑；桌上只有她的一本笔记和整齐的文具。
data.action: 用铅笔核对笔记，把漏掉的符号记在便签上再抬眼。
data.mood: 跨越校际的秘密恋爱、纯情美好
data.promptProse: Kaoruko Waguri sits at the community-library wooden table in her white-and-navy Kikyo uniform, checking a notebook line slowly with her pencil. She transfers a missing symbol to a sticky note, then looks up with a gentle blue-eyed smile. Only her one notebook and orderly stationery occupy the desk. Warm desk light falls on the paper and pleated collar, with small pencil shadows and a quieter shelf row beyond her dark-purple hair.
